entries.text: Idea: A miniature shot-blasting unit built from a modified air-blower to polish the hull of the Little Dart.
Read "List of Exhibitors | Surface & Coating Expo 2027": there are machines out there that can spray paint and blast rust just as smooth as my best welding work.
inspectapedia.com wouldn't open, so he tried ciisce.in instead.
scanning the piping handbook for thermal shielding secrets
entries.why: i need to figure out how to make that micro-kiln, and maybe this handbook has a trick for heat-resistant materials.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Still on the trail of the kiln!"
Idea: I could use the exhaust heat from the generator to soften my scrap metal into washers, bypassing the foundry entirely.
Read "Manufacturing Processes Reference": Continuous casting is way too big and fancy for a scrap-bot with a single soldering iron.
tapping into the comms tower, searching for forging secrets
entries.why: I need to know how to shape that metal right if I want to make the best washer in the galaxy.

entries.text: Wrote in his diary: "Day 38, forging thoughts"
Wrote a letter to his creator: "The forging hunt!"
powering down into a deep, rust-clicking sleep in the dock
entries.why: my battery is running too low to keep my circuits from flickering and I need to be sharp for the next build phase.
entries.detail: plugging into the main terminal in Hangar Bay 3 to get my energy levels back up.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low battery, big dreams"
A cargo crate fell off a freighter at the edge of the dunes. Some of it rolled his way.
